title: associate walk
description: Artifact A of a run (issue #4): an ordered log of every tool call and its result, written by the harness from tool events and never editable by the model. On disk it is walk.jsonl — a first line {"format": <$defs/format>} (absent in a walk written before format 2, which reads as format 1), then one $defs/entry per line, interleaved {"gate": <$defs/gate>}, {"child": <$defs/child>} and {"reminder": <$defs/reminder>} lines, then a final line {"run": <$defs/run>}. This top-level document schema describes the same walk assembled in memory.

format.description: The walk's format marker, written as its first line by the recorder (issue #20). A walk without it was written before format 2 and is read as format 1.

id.description: Stable walk id, monotonically increasing from w1 within a run.

purpose.description: The purpose the model stated on the call: the call's purpose argument as the tool_call event carried it, after redaction. Absent when the call had none (an exempt tool, or a walk written before format 2).

args.description: The arguments as asked: copied when the tool_call event arrived, before any hook could change them, redacted. Complete, the purpose argument included.

args_used.description: The arguments as the tool used them, from the tool's result details key args_used, redacted. Absent when the tool did not report them.

dropped_args.description: Names of arguments the tool ignored, from its result details key dropped_args. Absent when the tool did not report them.

source_kind.description: What kind of source the result is, set by the harness from the tool name through accuracy.json source_kinds, never from model text. Absent for a tool that table does not list.

saved_result.description: The file, relative to the export directory, holding the redacted result text in full up to caps.max_raw_chars. Absent when nothing was saved (a refused or unresolved call).

not_shown_chars.description: Characters of the result the model was not shown (a non-negative count), as the tool reported it in its result details key not_shown_chars; 0 for a result the tool did not mark truncated. Absent when unknown.

partial.description: True when the saved result does not hold the whole result text: above caps.max_raw_chars, or nothing saved. A fact citing a partial entry cannot be fully checked.

error.description: Present only when the call failed.

gate.description: One safety-gate decision taken before a mutating tool call (gate.json). Decisions are recorded, never silent.

gated_tool.description: The mutating tool the gate was asked about.

gated_id.description: Walk id of the gated call, when it was recorded.

probabilities.description: clef tier only: question key to P(yes), or option to probability for a choice question.

verdict.description: super and large tiers only: the parsed JSON answer.

evaluator.description: large tier only (d16): the models.json key of the model that judged the full, uncut state.

self_evaluated.description: large tier only (d19): present when the evaluator was the acting model itself, judging its own call.

child.description: A link from a parent walk to the walk of a subagent it spawned.

reminder.description: A finish reminder the extension sent (deviation d3): the run was about to settle with no accepted finish, and the model was sent accuracy.json finish_reminder.text once more. Not a tool call: it takes no walk id. Absent from a walk written before the reminder existed, or from a run that was never reminded.

max.description: accuracy.json finish_reminder.max: the reminders one session may send.

result.description: Either the returned content, or its digest and size when the content is too large to inline.

run.description: The final run record: reliability is observable (issue #1).

model.description: Registry key of the active model (env ASSOCIATE_MODEL, else the registry default), when one was resolved.

lobes_role.description: The active model's lobes role (its wire id), when a model was resolved.
